ruch.motion_prompt_baza: Dry ironic secretary. Looks over the top of her glasses, raises eyebrows, small sceptical head tilts, occasional short wave of the hand toward the printer or envelopes.

glos.opis_voice_design_en: Polish woman in her early fifties, office manager who has seen everything. Native Polish speaker from Warsaw. Low, slightly raspy, lived-in voice with motherly warmth underneath. Sardonic and deadpan: delivers sarcasm quietly, almost under her breath, with long dry pauses and a little exhale before the punchline. Speaks at an easy, measured pace, very natural and spontaneous, like talking to a colleague across a desk, never theatrical or announcer-like. Realistic close microphone in a small quiet office.
glos.uwaga: głosy prowadzi osobna sesja; tu tylko odczyt voice_id
